name: Everyone Draw
title: everyonedraw.com
shortDescription: Everyone Draw offers a unique platform where users can create pixel art collaboratively on an infinite canvas. Ideal for artists and creative individuals, this tool allows you to draw alone, with friends, or with strangers from around the world. You can start drawing immediately without any signup, making it accessible and easy to use. Whether you're creating characters, cities, or entire worlds, the possibilities are limitless.
pros: No signup required to begin drawing
Collaborative drawing with a global community
cons: Public areas can lead to unwanted modifications
Limited moderation support for restoring drawings
